name: My Stepmom is a Futanari 4
source:
Your stepmom, Fiona, has a condition called hyperlactation.
It means that she lactates excessively and spontaneously.

It can trigger at any moment, and when it does, Fiona is desperate for relief.
Luckily she's been able to monetize her predisposition and turn it into a decent income to support the household and pay your tuition.

And though accidents happen, it's no use crying over spilled milk.

[From [url=https://owlyboi.itch.io/my-stepmom-is-a-futanari-4]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的继母菲奥娜患有一种叫做哺乳过度的病症。
这意味着她自发地过度哺乳。

它随时可能触发，当它触发时，菲奥娜迫切需要解脱。
幸运的是，她能够将自己的倾向货币化，并将其转化为体面的收入来养家糊口并支付学费。

即使发生意外，为打翻的牛奶哭泣也是没有用的。

[来自[url=https://owlyboi.itch.io/my-stepmom-is-a-futanari-4]Itch.io[/url]]
